items.title: Apply the proven story-scoped validate execution lock implementation
items.context: Use the already-proven diff from /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound-validate-lock-proof: add validation-execution-lock, wrap validate command execution, and wrap done_required_validate with the same story lock. Keep the lock story-scoped and host-neutral.
items.userSees: After the implementation build, the terminal shows TypeScript build success and validate/done_required_validate use the same story-scoped validation execution lock without changing unrelated workflow commands.

happy.desc: A normal story validate command acquires and releases a lock scoped by project, story id, and worktree so same-story duplicate execution cannot overlap.

edge.desc: A different story/worktree can still validate concurrently, and stale validation locks can be reclaimed without blocking future work forever.

adversarial.desc: Reviewer pass writes, delivery_check_set writes, story_advance internal validate, and done_required_validate are not self-deadlocked or incorrectly blocked by the validate lock.

items.title: Carry the red/green validate lock regression smoke into the story worktree
items.context: Reuse validate-execution-lock-smoke as the red-to-green regression. It must cover same story exclusion, different worktree concurrency, reviewer and delivery metadata writes, story_advance internal validate, stale recovery, reentrancy, and done_required_validate sharing the lock.

items.title: Record story-to-DONE experiment friction and timing
items.context: This story is an experiment: problem and solution were already proven before story creation. Record any friction such as dirty canonical root, bootstrap/build prerequisites, stale evidence, or DONE gate loops in the final summary.
